CustomField.description: The deal phase this group belongs to. Moves the phase mapping out of the hardcoded PHASES map in transactionTaskGroups.js and into data: Open Contract covers A and B, Due Diligence covers C D E F G H and H2, Closing Prep covers I, Post-Closing covers J. FREE TEXT, NOT A PICKLIST - a Custom Metadata Type field cannot reference another object value set, which is the same constraint Stage_Threshold_Def__mdt.Stage_Value__c already records. The value must match Transaction__c.Stage__c EXACTLY, including the hyphen in Post-Closing, and NOT the Closing or Post Closing spellings the LWC and the FlexiPage tabs use today. A mismatch is rejected at DML by the restricted picklist on the checklist, not silently coerced.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Deal phase this group belongs to. Must match the deal Stage value exactly, for example Post-Closing with the hyphen.
CustomField.label: Stage
